source: Standing before the imposing gates of the Silvercrest manor, eyed by two guards and the city behind him, still abuzz with the news of the Life Blood skill book, Sam felt a lot of things.
target: Stans ante imponentes portas manerii Silvercrest, sub aspectu duorum custodum et urbis post eum, quae adhuc nuntiis de libro ingenii “Vitae Sanguinis” fervebat, Sam multa sensit.

source: He was laughing at the idiots that fought over that not‐at‐all rare book that would cause their demise in a year or two; he was annoyed that he had to dodge fights that randomly broke out in and outside of the city over the book; and most of all, he was curious what was the purpose of the lord calling him for a meeting.
target: Ridebat de ineptis, qui de hoc libro—non penitus raro, sed tali quo eorum perniciem intra annum vel duo afferret—certabant; iratus erat quod pugnas fortuito in urbe et extra eam de libro exarsantes vitare debebat; et maxime, mirabatur cur dominus eum convocare voluerit.

source: Because Sam was hundred percent sure that the excuse that his daughter liked Lucky was just that, an excuse.
target: Nam Sam totus certus erat excusatione, quod filia eius Lucky amaret, id solum esse—simply quendam rationem ad excusandum.

source: A man like Lord Silvercrest could buy hundreds of fluffy wolves for his daughter to play with.
target: Vir ut Dominus Silvercrest centenas luporum mollium emere posset, ut filiae suae ludere praebeat.

source: More than likely, he didn’t want anyone to know he was talking to an adventurer.
target: Verisimiliter noluit quisquam scire eum cum viatore colloqui.

source: Sighing quietly, throwing a glance at the rapidly counting down clock for the quest, he finally squared his shoulders and approached the gate guards.
target: Tacite suspirans, oculos intuebatur ad horologium expeditionis celeriter decrescentem, demum humeros rectos fecit et ad custodes portarum accessit.

source: “Halt, stranger!” called out one of them, while the other tightened their grip on their spear. “State your business!”
target: «Sta, peregrine!» inquit unus eorum, dum alter firmius hastam tenebat. «Dic negotium tuum!»

source: He bowed his head a little, then answered.
target: Paulum inclinavit caput, deinde respondit.

source: “Lord Silvercrest requested my presence,” he said simply, while the two guards exchanged a glance.
target: «Dominus Silvercrest praesentiam meam postulavit,» inquit leniter, dum duo custodes oculos inter se coniunctaverunt.

source: Finally, after a few seconds of silent communications, the other one shrugged and began walking towards the gate.
target: Denique, post aliquos secundos tacitae communicationis, alter humeros levavit et versus portas ambulare coepit.

source: “We will inform the Lord. For now, I would like to request that you wait here.”
target: «Dominum certiorem faciemus. Interim, te rogare velim, ut hic maneas.»

source: “Understood,” Sam answered and watched as the guard slipped in, while the remaining one was still eyeing him.
target: «Intelligo,» respondit Sam et observavit custodem intrare, dum reliquus eum adhuc spectabat.

source: He didn’t have to wait long, as a notification window popped up not even a minute after the second guard went inside.
target: Non multum exspectare debuit, nam fenestra nuntiorum apparuit ne minuto quidem postquam secundus custos intravit.

source: [The quest “Visit of the highest order!” has been completed!]
target: [Expeditio “Visitatio summi ordinis!” completa est!]

source: They didn’t have to wait long as the guard returned with a very stereotypical butler at their side.
target: Non multum exspectandum fuit, cum custos rediit cum servo domestico prorsus more consueto ad se.

source: The butler opened the gates enough for him to comfortably step through, while the guard who played the messenger returned to his post.
target: Servus domesticus portas satis aperuit, ut ille commode transiret, dum custos, qui nuntius fuit, ad locum suum rediit.

source: “If you would follow me, Sir?” motioned the butler, their face neutral and their voice almost devoid of emotion. Though, Sam thought he might have heard some kind of tightness in the voice.
target: «Si me secuteris, domine?» inquit servus domesticus, facie aequabili et voce quasi affectu carenta. Sed Sam putabat se aliquam tensionem in voce audivisse.

source: Keeping his observation to himself, he quietly thanked the butler, nodded to the guards and entered the manor grounds.
target: Observationem suam retinens, tacite ministrum domesticum gratias egit, ad custodes annuit et in area manerii intravit.

source: The manor looked exactly like Sam imagined a manor of a lord in a fantasy setting would look like.
target: Manerium prorsus ita videbatur, qualiter Sam repraesentaverat domum domini in mundo phantastico.

source: Marble, gold and weird paintings were everywhere.
target: Marmor, aurum, et picturae insolitae ubique erant.

source: The wooden panelling was, of course, made from ironwood, and the candle holders were made of ironworks.
target: Parietes lignei, scilicet ex ligno ferreo facti, erant; etiam sustentacula candelarum ex ferro confecta erant.

source: There was, of course, a lot of silver filigree and family crests around the halls, of course, also made from either silver, ironwood or simply iron.
target: Circa aedes, scilicet, multa erant filigrana argentea et sigilla familiarum, quae ex argento, ligno ferreo aut ferro simpliciter facta erant.

source: Sam never understood the taste of the rich…
target: Sam saporem divitorum nunquam intellexit…

source: Soon, they arrived in a room that looked like every other room they walked past, but Sam just shrugged.
target: Cito ad conclave pervenerunt, quod quasi omnium aliorum conclavium, quae transeunt, simile videbatur; sed Sam leviter humeros excussit.

source: At the polite behest of the butler, Sam took a seat and began waiting.
target: Secundum benigne imperium servi domestici, Sam sedes occupavit et exspectare coepit.

source: The butler bowed perfectly from the waist and left the room, closing the door.
target: Servus domesticus ex imis inclinavit et conclave reliquit, ianuam claudens.

source: Sam was about to wonder how long he would have to wait when the recently closed door almost exploded and he was once again face to face with the bombastic Lord Silvercrest, with the stone-faced butler standing behind him.
target: Sam paene mirari coepit, quamdiu exspectaret, cum ianuam nuper clausam paene explodere videbatur et iterum facie in faciem convenit cum bombastico Domino Silvercrest, servo domestico lapideo vultu post eum stante.

source: The man was dressed in fancy clothing, practically radiating wealth, though his blonde hair was not very well put together, and he could see something that suspiciously looked like shadows under the man’s eyes.
target: Vir indutus vestimentis pretiosis erat, opulentiam quasi effundens, quamquam capilli flavuli non optime dispositi erant, et aliquid sub oculis eius, quasi umbrae, apparuerunt.

source: Sam stood up and gave a small bow.
target: Sam surrexit et modice inclinavit.

source: “Greetings, Lord Silvercrest. As you have bid me, I’ve returned.”
target: «Salve, Domine Silvercrest. Sicut iussisti, redii.»

source: The man let out a boisterous laugh and then grinned at Sam. Then he squinted, and the smile on his face decreased a little.
target: Vir risum robustum effudit et deinde Sam subridens spectavit. Tum oculos contraxit, et risus in facie eius paulum decrevit.

source: “You did, my young friend! You did good! But, my new friend, it seems you’re missing somebody!”
target: «Fecisti, iuvenis amice! Bene egisti! Sed, novus amice, videtur te aliquem desiderare!»

source: Sam just grinned and motioned for his own shadow.
target: Sam tantum subridens signum dedit umbrae suae.

source: The man, followed by the butler, stared at it, and two eyes of a wolf blinked back at them.
target: Vir, a servo domestico secutus, ad eam spectavit, et duo oculi lupi ad eos reciprociter micaverunt.

source: The butler let out an almost silent ‘huh’ and the grin on the lord’s face grew two sizes.
target: Servus domesticus paene tacitum “heu” edidit, et risus in facie domini duplicato incremento auxit.

source: “Haha, what a marvellous development! Come, my friend, let us join my precious daughter!”
target: «Haha, quam mirabilis progressio! Veni, amice mi, accedamus ad filiam meam pretiosam!»

source: And with that the other man turned on a dime and left the room, leaving Sam blinking, at the spot where the lord stood.
target: Et hoc facto, alter vir celeriter se vertit et conclave reliquit, relinquens Sam palpebrantem in loco quo dominus stabat.

source: The butler simply spoke up.
target: Servus domesticus simpliciter locutus est.

source: “If the good Sir, would follow me once again?”
target: «Si, bone Domine, me iterum secuteris?»

source: Sam just sighed and began walking.
target: Sam tantum suspiravit et ambulare coepit.

source: The garden was rather refreshing compared to the interior of the manor.
target: Hortus admodum refrigerans videbatur respectu interioris manerii.

source: Sam expected sprawling hedge mazes, and precious flowers in stupendous arrangements, but what received him was everything but that.
target: Sam sperabat videre labyrinthos sepalos dilatatos et flores pretiosos in praeclaris compositionibus, sed quod eum receptum est, omnino aliter erat.

source: There were at least three different sparring rings, made of sand, at least a few sheds made of wood (ironwood, of course) probably holding weapons, Sam suspected, and while there was a very tastefully arranged gazebo, it was designed for comfort instead of beauty.
target: Erant saltem tres diversa circuli certaminis, ex arena facti, et pauca horrea ex ligno (scilicet ex ligno ferreo) fortasse armamenta continentes, ut Sam suspicabatur, et dum erat praeclare ordinata tenda solatii, ad commoditatem potius quam ad formositatem destinata.

source: And currently, it was hosting the young Lucrecia with an older woman looking exactly like the young friend of Lucky, just, well, older.
target: At nunc, in hoc loco hospitabant Lucreciam iuvenem cum muliere seniore, quae prorsus similis videbatur iuveni amico Lucky, sed evidentius seniora.

source: Though, now that Sam was getting closer, he could see that the older woman was moving as little as possible and looked rather faint.
target: Sed, cum Sam propius accessisset, animadvertit mulierem senorem vix moveri et languidam esse.

source: ‘Ahh, sick mother, boisterous father… probably enemies out of the wazoo. I bet I’ll need to retrieve a medicine…’ Sam speculated as he approached the family. ‘Or maybe remove a curse…’
target: «Ah, mater aegra, pater tumultuosus… fortasse hostes innumerabiles! Puto me medicamentum quaerere debere…» speculatus est Sam, dum ad familiam accessit.

source: The lord, heads taller than anyone else in the garden, was standing next to the gazebo and the moment Sam stepped close enough that the women of the family could see him, he began speaking.
target: Dominus, capite altiori quam omnis alius in horto, iuxta pavilionem stabat, et simul cum Sam satis accessit ut mulieres familiae eum intuerentur, coepit loqui.

source: Though for him, speaking was yelling.
target: Sed pro eo, loqui erat quasi clamare.

source: The young lady of the manor winced and sent him an apologetic look while the man’s wife just smiled indulgently at him.
target: Domina iuvenis manerii faciem contraxit et ei vultum excusationis misit, dum uxor viri indulgenter subridens spectabat.

source: “Look, my darling Lucrecia! Look who came to visit us!”
target: «Ecce, mea carissima Lucrecia! Ecce quis ad nos visitandum venit!»

source: “I can see, father. And could hear you from inside the house,” came the deadpan reply. The man just laughed harder. “Though I do not see the wolf.” She turned to him. “Sir adventurer, could you perhaps explain?”
target: «Vidi, pater. Et ex domo te audivi,» respondit sine inflectione. Vir autem magis risit. «Sed non video lupum.»

source: Sam just smiled and simply called out.
target: Sam solum subridens exclamavit.

source: “Lucky!”
target: «Lucky!»

source: There was a brief pause, then there was a quiet bark and Lucky resurfaced from the shadow beneath Sam.
target: Post brevem silentii spatium, parum sonitus latratus auditus est, et Lucky ex umbra sub Sam emergit.

source: The wolf jumped up, pranced a little in front of Sam, then stuck a pose and let out a howl.
target: Lupus surrexit, ante Sam parumper saltavit, deinde se in figuram constat posuit et ululavit.

source: “It’s soooo fluffy!”
target: «Tam molle est!»

source: Sam watched for a minute as the young girl and wolf played together, then looked up at the lord and lady of the manor, who were sitting in the gazebo, watching the playing duo with a smile.
target: Sam per momentum spectavit ut puella iuvenis et lupus simul ludere inciperent, deinde aspexit ad dominum et dominam manerii, qui in pavilione sedebant, duo ludentis subridentes observantes.

source: Lord Silvercrest motioned for him to join them, so he did so.
target: Dominus Silvercrest eum ad se iungendum invitavit, et ille se iunxit.

source: He calmly walked up and took a seat opposite the pair.
target: Calme accessit et sedem praepositam contra paria occupavit.

source: However, before he could speak up, the lord reached forward and gingerly touched the abstract decoration in the middle of the table.
target: Attamen, antequam loqui posset, dominus progressus est et commodatim ornamentum abstractum in medio mensae tetigit.

source: The moment his meaty fingers touched the decoration it lit up with gentle white light and Sam felt some kind of magic activating around them.
target: Cum digiti eius robusti ornamentum attigerunt, id momento luce alba leniter fulsit, et Sam sensit aliquam magiam circum se activari.

source: He raised an inquisitive eyebrow.
target: Supercilium inquisitivum levavit.

source: “Worry not, friend, just a little magic to make sure what we say stays here!” came the loud explanation from the lord.
target: «Noli metuere, amice; solum parva magia est ad curandum ut verba nostra hic manserint!» inquit dominus voce clara.

source: Sam nodded in understanding, suspecting that the people in the manor must be a master of that type of magic.
target: Sam annuit intellegens, suspiciens homines manerii esse peritos in illa magica.

source: “I understand, my lord. Now, perchance you may share with me the reason you called me here…” he simply said, then leaned back, looking directly into the man’s eyes.
target: «Intelligo, domine. Nunc, forsitan mihi rationem, qua me hic vocavisti, explices…» inquit simpliciter, deinde recubans, oculos in eius spectans.

source: “Smart man!” exclaimed the lord, then his entire demeanor shifted. Gone was the boisterous and happy lord, instead Sam was sitting across from a lord of a family, with an edge to them that made Sam a little nervous. Though the voice level didn’t go down.
target: «Ingeniosus vir!» exclamavit dominus, et totus habitus eius immutatus est. Abiit ille dominus festivus et sonorus, et Sam sedebat adversus dominum familiae, cuius acerbitas eum paulum movebat, quamquam vox eius non attenuata fuit.

source: “I called you here, young man because I needed someone unaffiliated with anyone. And the best ones are adventurers that work for money!”
target: «Te hic vocavi, iuvenis, quia opus mihi erat aliquem sine vinculis; et optimi sunt adventores, qui pro pecunia operantur!»

source: “That makes sense, my lord. Then, how can I be of service to the House of Silvercrest?”
target: «Hoc sensibile est, domine. Ergo, quomodo servire possum Domui Silvercrest?»

source: “Good attitude! Good attitude!” the man proclaimed, slapping the table, rattling the entire gazebo while his wife continued to sip her tea as if nothing interesting was happening.
target: «Bona indoles! Bona indoles!» proclamavit vir, mensam percussit, totum pavilionem concutens, dum uxor eius theam bibebat, quasi nihil insolitum ageretur.

source: “I shall be direct. Enemies of my house grew jealous of our wealth. They desire our silver mines, thus they conspired and managed to place a foul curse upon my wife.”
target: «Ego directe dicam. Inimici domus meae divitiam nostram invidere coeperunt. Fodinas argentarias nostras optaverunt, itaque conspiraverunt et maledictionem foedam super uxorem meam imposuerunt.»

source: “And you want me to help you to lift it.”
target: «Et vis ut tibi auxilior ut id tollam.»

source: “Excellent deduction, young man!”
target: «Excellens deductio, iuvenis!»

source: “Hmm… Do you know the name of the curse?”
target: «Hmm… Scisne nomen maledictionis?»

source: This time, the grin was replaced by a frown on the man’s face.
target: Hoc tempore, risus in facie viri evanuit, atque loco eius apparuit vultus contritus.

source: “Sadly, no. We scoured libraries all over the land, but we could find no mention of the curse. All we know is that it saps my darling’s energy. Every day she grows weaker.”
target: «Heu, minime. Bibliothecas per totam terram investigavimus, sed nullam mentionem maledictionis invenimus. Omne quod scimus est quod vim carissimae meae exhaurit; quotidie eam debilitari videmus.»

source: By the time he finished, he was almost whispering and throwing a worried gaze at his wife.
target: Cum finiret, fere susurrabat et vultum sollicitum ad uxorem suam iaciebat.

source: “I see,” Sam said simply, then raised a hand at the woman. “If I could?”
target: «Intelligo,» inquit Sam simpliciter, deinde manum ad mulierem levavit. «Si possem?»

source: There was a tense moment as the lord eyed him, but at a gentle touch from his wife, he relented.
target: Fuit momentum anxium dum dominus eum intuebatur, sed leni tactu uxoris cedere coepit.

source: “Go ahead, young man. Maybe you could see something that countless wise men have not!”
target: «Procede, iuvenis. Forsitan quid videas quod innumeri sapientes nondum viderunt!»

source: Sam nodded and activated several skills.
target: Sam annuit et varias artes activavit.

source: The first one was Mana Sense, focused on the woman, then Discernment, just to be sure and finally Mana Sight.
target: Prima erat “Sensus Manae”, in mulierem intendens, deinde “Discernmentum” ad certitudinem, et postremo “Visus Manae.”

source: Staring at the woman with both of his senses and eyesight, he could immediately spot the ugly, pulsating and rather foul black ball of mana in her body.
target: Observans mulierem omnibus sensibus et acuto visu, statim deprehendit globum nigrum, foedum, pulsantem mana in eius corpore.

source: Right at the level of her stomach.
target: Recte in regione ventris eius.

source: The pulse of the black ball of mana was the same as the mana circulating in the woman, but every time the woman’s mana circulated, it came back less and the black mana grew in size.
target: Pulsus globi nigrantis mana idem erat ac mana, quae in mulier circumfluens, sed quotiens mana eius circulabat, redibat minor atque globus niger in magnitudine crescebat.

source: It was a slow process, but as Sam focused on it, the surroundings started getting out of focus, and he could only see the woman.
target: Processus tardus erat, sed dum Sam in eam intendit, circumstantia evanescere coeperunt, et solum mulierem videre potuit.

source: Then even the woman was lost to his sight, and he was directly staring at the blue mana, infested by what was definitely some kind of foul mana parasite.
target: Tum etiam mulier ex conspectu eius evanuit, et ille directe intuebatur mana caeruleum, quod indubitanter aliquo genere foedi parasiti manae infestatum erat.

source: As he tried to make sense of the mess of tangled webs of mana in the woman’s body, he also tried to sift through his inherited memories, trying to figure out if the other Sam ever came across something like that or maybe heard about it.
target: Dum conabatur sensum facere in confusione reticulorum intricatorum mana in corpore mulieris, etiam hereditarias memorias suas perquirere conatus est, ut sciret utrum alius Sam aliquando huiusmodi aliquid occurrisset aut de eo audivisset.

source: He was about to give up and curse the fact that the inherited memories didn’t come with a convenient search engine when he found it.
target: Iam prope relinquere et maledicere quod memoriae hereditatis non venissent cum instrumento quaerendi commode, cum eam reperit.

source: “Right! The Ironwood Monster Break! Somehow, a portal was opened in the city and foul monsters started pouring out.”
target: «Recte! Fractio Monstrorum Ligni Ferrei! Quidam modo in urbe portae apertae sunt et monstra foeda effluere coeperunt.»

source: At first, he wasn’t sure that it was connected to this parasite, but then another very faint memory resurfaced.
target: Primum non certus erat an id huic parasito pertinere posset, sed deinde alia memoria valde tenue recidit.

source: “If I remember correctly… there was a mention of battles for the silver mines after the Monster Break…”
target: «Si bene memini… mentionem fuisse proeliis pro fodinis argentariis post Fractio Monstrorum Ligni Ferrei…»

source: He closed his eyes, slowly turning his skills off, then leaned back and began to consolidate what he figured out.
target: Oculos clausit, paulatim artes suas deactivans, deinde recubuit et ea quae intellexerat consolidare coepit.

source: “If I’m right, then more than likely, this ball of mana is what would open the portal. Probably will use up the life force of the lady, then bamm… monsters everywhere… But how to remove it?”
target: «Si recte memini, hoc globus mana verisimiliter portam aperiet. Fortasse vim vitae dominae consumet, deinde monstra ubique apparebunt… Sed quomodo id removere possum?»

source: And wasn’t that the million dollar question…
target: Et nonne quaestio illa, vera quaestionis summae pretii, esset…

source: Sam opened his eyes, and glanced at his notifications.
target: Sam oculos aperuit et ad nuntios suos aspexit.

source: [You have discovered something new but horrible with your senses!]
target: [Novum, sed horribile, per sensus tuos detexisti!]

source: [Your skill Mana Sense became Level 15!]
target: [Ars tua “Sensus Manae” gradum XV pervenit!]

source: [Your subskill Focused Sense became level 3!]
target: [Sub-ars “Sensum Focalizatam” gradum III pervenit!]

source: [Your skill Mana Sight became level 5!]
target: [Ars tua “Visus Manae” ad gradum V pervenit!]

source: Dismissing them, he turned his attention to his hosts.
target: Eos deiecit et animadvertit in hospites suos.

source: “Well, from what I can see, you don’t have much time left. That thing is eating the lady’s life force. I can’t even fathom what it will achieve when it consumes the last drop. I assume you have a basic plan?”
target: «Bene, ex eo quod video, non habetis multum temporis reliquum. Illa res vim vitae dominae devorat. Nequaquam intelligo quid fiet cum ultima gutta absorbetur. Puto vos consilium fundamentale habere!»

source: The man nodded grimly, while his giant hand engulfed one of the woman’s tiny ones.
target: Vir graviter annuit, dum manus eius ingens unum ex parvis manibus mulieris amplectebatur.

source: “Indeed, young man. Through research and contacts, I found an artefact that is capable of housing and transferring such spirits without damaging the previous host. However…”
target: «Revera, iuvenis, per investigationes et relationes inveni artificium, quod talia spiritus continere ac transferre possit sine hosti praecedenti laedendo. Sed…»

source: “However, you need somebody to get it. And you can’t leave her, because then…”
target: «Sed oportet te aliquem habere ad id obtinendum; neque eam relinquere potes, nam tunc…»

source: “You are perceptive, young man!” burst out the man, and the woman gave him a small smile.
target: «Perspicax es, iuvenis!» exclamavit vir, et mulier ei parvum risum dedit.

source: “Let me tell you the details!”
target: «Permitte mihi ut tibi singula enarram!»

source: Before the man could start, Sam held up a hand.
target: Priusquam vir incipere posset, Sam manum levavit.

source: “And what makes you think that you can trust me with this? By all accounts, I could be a plant by your enemies…”
target: «Et quid te facit putare te posse mihi hoc in fidem tradere? Omnibus indicibus, fortasse ego speculum aut “plant” ab hostibus tuis esse possim…»

source: His only response was laughter from the man and an elegant chuckle from the lady.
target: Responsum eius unicum fuit risus ab viro et lepidus subridens ex parte dominae.

source: “Nobody who has a pet like that could be an evil person!” came the baffling reply. “Plus, I have this nifty thing here!”
target: «Nemo, qui talem animal domesticum habeat, malus esse potest!» inquit responsum perplexum. «Praeterea, hanc rem eleganter habeo!»

source: With that, the lord of the manor placed a parchment radiating magic in front of Sam.
target: Hoc facto, Dominus manerii charta magiam radiante ante Sam posuit.

source: He immediately recognized it. And not for good reasons.
target: Id statim agnovit; neque propter causas bonas.

source: The parchment was yellow, with dark red, almost black edges, and to his Mana Sight, it was almost as if it was bleeding mana.
target: Charta flavissima erat, cum marginibus rubris obscuris, paene nigris, et, secundum “Visum Manae” eius, quasi mana stillabant.

source: A Blood Contract…
target: Pactum Sanguinis…

source: Sam left the Silvercrest manor in a daze, with Lucky, exhausted, back in his shadow, staring at the window in front of him.
target: Sam manerium Silvercrest in stupefactum reliquit, et Lucky, defessus, in umbra eius versatus, ad fenestram coram se intuebatur.

source: [You signed a Blood Contract!]
target: [Pactum Sanguinis subscripsisti!]

source: [If you break the terms of the contract, your life is forfeit, along with several other punishments!]
target: [Si conditiones pacti violaveris, vita tua peribit, una cum plurimis poenis!]

source: [You are marked by the magic of the contract until you fulfil it!]
target: [Magia pacti te signavit, donec id adimpleas!]

source: [You received a new quest!]
target: [Novam expeditio acceperis!]

source: [A shadow in a shadow of a shadow!]
target: [Umbra in umbra in umbra!]

source: [Lord Silvercrest has entrusted you with retrieving the Chalice of Restraint, used for housing and transporting belligerent spirits in the olden days. However, the House of Silvercrest has enemies around every corner, so be careful! You also signed a Blood Contract with Lord Silvercrest as a sign of trust, beware of the terms, lest you suffer a fate worse than death!]
target: [Dominus Silvercrest tibi commisit ut Calicem Coercitionis recuperares, ad quem spiritus bellicosi in antiquis temporibus continebantur et transportabantur. Attamen, Domus Silvercrest hostibus ubique infestata est, ergo cave! Etiam cum Domino Silvercrest Pactum Sanguinis subscripsisti ut fides demonstraretur; cave conditiones, ne tibi fatum peius quam mors eveniat!]

source: [Time Limit: As long as Lady Silvercrest lives.]
target: [Tempus: Quamdiu Domina Silvercrest vivit.]

source: [Failure: Lady Silvercrest dies. You don’t deliver the Chalice of Restraint.]
target: [Defectio: Domina Silvercrest moritur. Calicem Coercitionis non tradis.]

source: [Penalty: Death. One year 90% EXP penalty and the permanent loss of one from every base stat.]
target: [Poena: Mors. Unum annum poenae EXP 90% et detractio perpetua unius ex omnibus statibus principalibus.]

source: [Reward: The undying gratitude of the House of Silvercrest. You can hire young Lucrecia as a follower. Additional rewards are possible.]
target: [Praemium: Aeterna gratitudo Domus Silvercrest. Potes iuvenem Lucreciam conducere ut sequax. Praemia addita possibilia sunt.]

source: He stared at the sentence ‘Additional rewards are possible.’ and couldn’t help but feel happy, but still want to despair.
target: Ille aspexit sententiam “Praemia addita possibilia sunt” et non potuit non gaudere, sed simul desperare quoque.

source: It was a rather famous sentence. It basically meant that the quest had some hidden elements that he would need to solve if he wanted to finish it.
target: Sententia erat satis famosa. Fundamentum eius significabat expeditio quaedam elementa abscondita habere, quae solvere oporteret si eam finire vellent.

source: Which meant complications. At least it was an early quest, so it wouldn’t take much time. And based on how developed the parasite was, he had at most one-month in-game time before the Monster Break occurred, if he was right about that.
target: Quae implicabat complicationes. Saltem expeditio prima erat, ergo non multum temporis caperet. Et, secundum quam evoluta esset parasitus, ad summum unum mensem intra tempus ludi ante Fractio Monstrorum habebatur, si recte putabat.

source: Sighing and lamenting his weird luck, Sam ducked into an alley, and if somebody were watching that alley, the man that came out on the other end looked nothing like Sam, be it their face or clothing.
target: Suspirans et fortunam suam miram lamentans, Sam in angustum viculum se recepit, et si quis illum viculum observasset, vir qui ex altera parte apparuit omnino a Sam dissimilis videbatur, nec in facie nec in vestimentis.
